name: IcePanel
description:
Bring your software architecture diagrams and model into Claude.

Access model objects, connections, ADRs, and diagrams in IcePanel. Understand how your system's designed, before making changes in code manually or with an agent. Update your model and decision records automatically.

_published_faq.name: How do I add IcePanel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add IcePanel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.icepanel.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the IcePanel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: IcePanel lists 24 MCP tools, including icepanel_createADR, icepanel_createConnection, icepanel_createModelObject, icepanel_getADRDetails, icepanel_getConnectionDetails, icepanel_getDiagramDetails, icepanel_getDomainDetails, icepanel_getFlowDetails, icepanel_getModelObjectDetails, icepanel_getTeamDetails, icepanel_getTechnologyDetails, and icepanel_landscapeSearch.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to IcePanel?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to IcePanel in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
IcePanel requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
IcePanel is developed by IcePanel. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
